sender.hr: Internetska trgovina ili oglas na društvenoj mreži
sender.en: An online shop or a social media ad

name.hr: Lažna internetska trgovina: velika rasprodaja, roba nikad ne stigne
name.en: Fake online shop: huge sale, goods never arrive

how.hr: Oglas ili trgovina nudi poznate marke uz ogromne popuste, odbrojavanje i „posljednje komade“, ili priču o zatvaranju obiteljske trgovine i rasprodaji zbog odlaska u mirovinu. Platite karticom, a proizvod nikad ne stigne ili stigne bezvrijedna kopija. Podaci kartice mogu se zloupotrijebiti. Posebno često uoči Crnog petka i blagdana.
how.en: An ad or shop offers famous brands at huge discounts, with countdowns and “last items”, or a story about a family shop closing and a retirement clearance sale. You pay by card and the product never arrives, or a worthless copy does. Your card details may be misused. Especially common before Black Friday and the holidays.

text.en: Unbelievably low prices for famous brands.

text.hr: Nepoznata stranica do koje ste došli preko oglasa.
text.en: An unknown site you reached through an ad.
Payment by card or bank transfer in advance.

text.hr: ZATVARAMO TRGOVINU nakon 32 godine 😢 Sve jakne i čizme -80% dok traju zalihe! Hvala vam na vjernosti. Narudžbe primamo još samo 24 sata: [poveznica]
text.en: WE’RE CLOSING THE SHOP after 32 years 😢 All jackets and boots -80% while stocks last! Thank you for your loyalty. We’re taking orders for just 24 more hours: [link]

en: ordered but it never arrived webshop
paid by card goods never came

hr: Popusti od 70 do 90 % na poznate marke.
Emotivne priče o zatvaranju i odbrojavanje vremena.
Nema stvarne adrese, OIB-a ni recenzija izvan same stranice.
Traže uplatu na račun umjesto sigurnog plaćanja.
en: Discounts of 70 to 90% on famous brands.
Emotional closing-down stories and countdown timers.
No real address, company ID or reviews outside the site itself.
They ask for a bank transfer instead of secure payment.

hr: Prije kupnje provjerite trgovinu u CERTiffyju i potražite iskustva drugih kupaca.
Plaćajte karticom koja podržava povrat (chargeback) ili virtualnom karticom.
Ako ste prevareni, javite se banci i prijavite stranicu CERT-u i policiji.
en: Before buying, check the shop in CERTiffy and look for other buyers’ reviews.
Pay with a card that supports chargebacks or a virtual card.
If you were scammed, contact your bank and report the site to CERT and the police.
